title: Astro #14803: Image tests crash from circular reference in CSS plugin

error_signal.message: astro Error: out of memory crash caused by circular reference in vite-plugin-css when dev CSS plugin invalidates image.css during loading creating infinite loop

ground_truth.root_cause_description: Circular reference in CSS plugin - dev CSS plugin invalidates image.css during loading, causing the page to never finish loading until OOM.
ground_truth.fix_description: Break circular invalidation by checking if module is already being loaded
